newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli businessmen to meet Palestinian official.
newsitem.headline: Israeli businessmen to meet Palestinian official.

text.p: A group of Israeli business executives will on Tuesday meet the Palestinian Industry and Trade Minister, Maher al-Masri, the Federation of Israeli Chambers of Commerce said on Monday.

"It's really the first meeting of its kind since the elections, and it is occurring despite the events of last week and the closure of the territories," federation chairman Danny Gillerman told Reuters.
Tuesday's meeting will take place at the ministry in the West Bank town of Ramallah at 1000 GMT. Two Jewish settlers were killed in a drive-by killing in the West Bank last week.

Israel imposed a four-month closure on the West Bank and Gaza Strip earlier this year after Islamic militants carried out four suicide bombings. The closure has since been eased but tough restrictions remain.

Gillerman, head of the delegation, said the Israelis would be seeking a reversal of a Palestinian Authority decision to prohibit Israeli agents and importers from bringing goods into Palestinian areas.
After two postponements, Gillerman said, the ban is due to go into effect on January 1.
"They sent out a circular to all the multinationals around the world" about the ban, he said.
The two sides will also discuss joint economic development, including ways of easing the movement of people and goods over the border, and investment.
The two sides have held talks from time to time, but this will be their first meeting since the election of the right-wing government headed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
